notes.title: Having Trouble With a Level?
notes.content:
[h1]Need a solution to a difficult level?[/h1]
Bloxiq VR is a delicate balance of beauty and complexity but we want players to have a resource guide so that they can actually get past a puzzle that they get stuck on.

The link below will take you to the official walkthrough videos for Worlds 1 -6. World 7 is completely up to skill and technique. Have fun puzzlers!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLR8SQfMnobwEQDr7JF42Pz05B7Ie0Au4m]Bloxiq VR Walkthrough Video Playlist[/url]

P.S. If you have your own crazy way of solving some difficult levels then feel free to share them on the community page!
